main_text.p: pendendi Oracula Prophetarum accen-datur, recitabo præclara quædá Spiritus sancti apophthegmata, quæ in Nouo Testamento & Patrum quorundam orthodoxorum libris, uelut radiantes quędam stellæ, emicant: & Prophetarum τῷ ἀξιώ-ματί fidem nostram fulciunt & confirmat.

Act.10.43. Huic Iesu Christo omnes Prophetæ testimonium ferunt, quòd remissionem peccatorū accepturus sit per nomen eius, omnis qui crediderit in e-um. Ex hoc dicto κεφαλαιωδῶς colligimus, 1. Suauissimam esse Veteris & Noui Testamenti ministrorum συμφωνίαν. 2. Cum utriq; Christo testimonium perhibeant, quòd sit Saluator mundi. 3. Ac doceat, nullo alio quàm fidei instrumento Christum à nobis apprehendi ad salutem nostram. Certò itaq; nobis persuasum esse debet, in Ionæ prophetæ historia & cōcionibus nihil esse magis spectandum, quàm μαρτύριον περὶ τῆς χάριτος, quod studiosi & religiosi iuuenes nō tantùm in signo Ionæ, sed etiā in exèplo pœnitetiæ Ninivitarum, & remissionis peccatorū, quæ illis fide in Mesfia benedictū ad iusticiā imputata, concessa fuit, spectare debent.

page.notes: Greek words are approximate: "ἀξιώ-ματί" (line-end hyphen), "κεφαλαιωδῶς" and "μαρτύριον περὶ τῆς χάριτος" are hard to read at this scan resolution, so verify them against the original. The bottom "2.Pet." is read as a catchword by position, but it may be a marginal reference. Printed "Mefsia" and "exèplo" are kept as printed.
